prompt_text: A retired stage magician becomes the night janitor at a museum of failed inventions.
In a city where memories are taxed, your protagonist starts a memory smuggling ring.
A mountain town wakes to find that every shadow points in a different direction.
An emergency broadcast interrupts every song on Earth with the same unknown melody.
After a century asleep, a lighthouse turns itself back on in a desert.
A civil engineer discovers the city map changes whenever she lies.
Your protagonist receives weather reports that describe emotions instead of storms.
A courier must deliver one sealed letter before sunrise, but every street loops.
